description.narrative:
Enterprising Futures Scholarship
This report outlines how this mission comes together in the Enterprising Futures Scholarship, a partnership set up between One Young World, the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Orange Corners.
Since 2018, One Young World has collaborated with the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) and Orange Corners to elevate the work of impressive young entrepreneurs. The previous Enterprise for Peace Programme which ran from 2018 - 2022 saw 185 young leaders from over 30 countries participate in One Young World’s programme. Throughout the four years of the programme, Enterprise for Peace Ambassadors have been inspired to make a difference by world leaders, experts and peers. Ambassadors reported improved capacity to generate impact, an increased network of support, significant development of their social impact initiatives, and enhanced legitimacy as leaders in their field.
Building on the success of the 2018 - 2022 Enterprise for Peace Programme, One Young World along with the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Orange Corners created the Enterprising Futures Scholarship which runs from 2023 - 2026. The Enterprising Futures Scholarship selected 40 young leaders who are working to improve young people’s prospects and increase youth engagement in a number of developing countries and fragile states, by supporting local entrepreneurs and job creation.

sector.narrative: A London-based NGO which is the global community for young leaders. We platform the work of exceptional young leaders, from activists, and entrepreneurs to politicians who are all making a measurable positive impact in the world today. These young leaders are on the frontlines of the global challenges we all face. Our Community of over 17,500 young leaders from over 190 countries.
